description: This Java class defines the 'Holiday' entity within the Fineract project, representing holiday periods with attributes like dates, status, description, and associated offices. It includes methods for creating, updating, activating, and deleting holiday instances, along with validation logic.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday period with attributes like name, dates, status, description, rescheduling type, and associated offices. Includes methods for creation, updates, activation, deletion, and validation.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new Holiday instance based on provided offices and JSON command input, setting attributes like name, dates, rescheduling type, and description.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Holiday instance's attributes based on the provided JSON command, with validation depending on current status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the set of associated offices; returns true if the set was changed.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the holiday if it is in pending activation state; throws validation exception if not.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the holiday as deleted if it is not already in deleted state; throws validation exception if already deleted.

methods.name: getReScheduleType
methods.description: Returns the rescheduling type as an enum based on the stored integer value.
